steps.instruction:
Say, “Look at me.”
【说】“看我”

Present the image of three cups, the left
with a block below it (FLS-2a), pause for 5
seconds and turn the page.
【等待】5秒，然后翻页

Present the image of three cups (FLS-2b).
Say, “Where did the block go?”
【说】“积木去哪里了？”

Say, “Do this,”
and touch each star one at a time from your
right to your left.
【说】“这样做”
【动作】从右边向左边触摸每一颗星星。

Say, “Choose one.”
【说】“选一个”

Say, “Do this,” and touch your nose.
【说】“这样做”
【动作】触摸你的鼻子。

Say, “Do this,” and make a pincer grasp
(pinching motion) with your fingers.
【说】“这样做”
【动作】用手指做出钳形（捏的动作）

Say, “Do this,” and purse your lips.
【说】“这样做”
【动作】噘起你的嘴唇。（嘟嘴）

Say, “Do this,” and raise your right arm, then
touch your stomach.
【说】“这样做”
【动作】举起你的右臂，然后触摸你的肚子

Say, “Say…Ahh.”
【说】“说...啊”

Say, “Say…Book.”
【说】“说...书包”(备注：汉化双音节）

Say, “Stand up.”
【说】“起立”（“站起来”）

Say, “Jim says, ‘Hi!’ What do you say?”
【说】“大明说，‘你好’，你说什么？”

Say, “Say…The dog is big!”
【说】“说...这只狗很大！”

Point to the block at the top of the page.
Say, “Show me same.”
【动作】指向页面顶部的那块积木。
【说】“指一样的”（或者“摸相同的”或者“哪一个是一样
的/相同的”

Point to the apple at the top of the page.
Say, “Show me same.”
【动作】指向页面顶端的苹果。
【说】“指一样的”（或者“摸相同的”或者“哪一个是一样
的/相同的”

Point to the T at the top of the page.
Say, “Show me same.”
【动作】指向页面顶端的T。
【说】“指一样的”（或者“摸相同的”或者“哪一个是一样
的/相同的”

Point to the dime at the top of the page.
Say, “Show me same.”
【动作】指向页面顶端的1角人民币。
【说】“指一样的”（或者“摸相同的”或者“哪一个是一样
的/相同的”

Say, “Show me the stuffed animal.”
【说】“指毛绒玩具”（也可以是“摸毛绒玩具”或者“哪一
个是毛绒玩具？”）

Say, “Show me the toothbrush.”
【说】“指牙刷”（也可以是“摸牙刷”或者哪一个是牙
刷？）”

Say, “Show me the bread.”
【说】“指面包”（也可以是“摸面包”或者哪一个是面
包？）”

Say, “Show me the horse.”
【说】“指马”（也可以是“摸马”或者”哪一个是马？”）

Say, “Clap loudly.”
【说】“大声拍手”

Say, “What is your name?”
【说】“你叫什么名字？”

Say, “What is this?”
【说】“这是什么？”

Say, “What is this?”
【说】“这是什么？”

Say, “Point to your knee.”
【说】“指向你的膝盖”

Say, “Show me the rectangle.”
【说】“指长方形”（“摸长方形”或者“哪一个是长方形？”）

Say, “Show me brown.”
【说】“指棕色”（也可以是“摸棕色”或“哪一个是棕色？”）

Say, “Show me the flower.”
【说】“指花”（也可以是“摸花”或“哪一个是花？”）.”

Say, “Show me H.”
【说】“指H”（也可以是“摸H”或“哪一个是H？”）

Say, “What is this?”
【说】“这是什么？”

Say, “What color is this?”
【说】“这是什么颜色？”

Say, “Say…ribbit.”
【说】“说...呱呱（青蛙叫声）”

Say, “Stand up, turn around, and clap your
hands.”
【说】“起立，转身，并拍手。”

Say, “What comes next? L-M-N-O-…”
【说】“接下来是什么？L-M-N-O-...”

Say, “What number is this?”
【说】“这是什么数字？”

Say, “Which letter says ‘mmm’?”
【说】“哪个字母是‘mmm’”

Say, “Which one is crying?”
【说】“哪一个在哭？”

Say, “Tell me something that has spots.”
【说】“告诉我有斑点的东西”（或者“说一个有斑点的东
西”)

Say, “Who is this?”
【说】“这是谁？”

Say, “Which one is feeling wet?”
【说】“哪一个感觉是湿的？”

Say, “Which one doesn’t belong?”
【说】“哪一个不属于？”（或者“哪一个不是一类？”“哪
一个不一样？）

VCS-11
Say, “Bob’s balloon popped. What might he
be feeling?”
【说】“鲍勃的气球爆炸了，他可能会是什么心情（感
觉）？”

Say, “Which one is 9:30?”
【说】“哪一个是9：30？”

Say, “What does it say?”
【说】“怎么读？” (汉化成拼音）

Say, “What group does this belong to?”
【说】“这是属于什么类的？”

Say, “Where are they?”
【说】“他们在那？”

Say, “Show me his head.”
【说】“摸男孩的头”（或“指男孩的头”)(汉化）

Point to the nickel, and
say, “How much is this coin worth?”
指向1角镍币，并说“这枚硬币值多少钱？”

Say, “Which one is fifteen cents?”
【说】“哪一个是1元钱？”（汉化）

Say, “How many dots are there?”
Then turn the page.
【说】“有多少个点？”
然后翻页

Say, “How many are there now?”
【说】“现在有多少个?”

Say, “How much is it?”
【说】“是多少？”（答案是多少）

Say, “If you were this tornado, how would
you feel?”
【说】“如果你是龙卷风，你会感觉如何？”（你感觉怎
么样？）

Say, “What is 4 + 0?”
【说】“4+0是多少？”

Say, “Guess how many items are inside.”
【说】“猜猜里面有多少物品”

Say, “Give the bunny a name based on what
he looks like.”
【说】“根据长相给兔子起一个名字”

Say, “What do you think is inside?”
【说】“你觉得里面是什么？”

Say, “Show me the traveler.”
【说】“哪一个旅行的时候使用？”（“指一指旅游用
的”“哪一个用来旅行”）

Say, “The fast car is red.”
Turn the page.
【说】“那辆快车是红色的。”
【动作】翻页

Wait ten seconds.
Say, “Tell me what I said.”
【等待】10秒钟，然后
【说】“我刚才说了什么？”

Point to the image of an airplane at the top.
Say, “What else is the same?”
【动作】指着页面顶端的飞机图片
【说】“还有什么相同的？”

Say, “Tell me three things about this.”
【说】“告诉我关于这个的三件事（三个方面，三个特
征）”

Point to the image of a pillow.
Say, “Choose what I might be feeling right
now.”
动作】指向枕头的图片。
【说】“选择我现在可能是什么感觉”

Point to the image of the man.
Say, ““What might he be feeling right
now?”
动作】指向男人的图片。
【说】“他现在是什么感觉（心情）？”

Say, “What do you think happens next?”
【说】“你认为接下来会发生什么？”

Say, “Do this,” and clap your hands then
place them on your head.
【说】“这样做”
【动作】拍拍你的手，然后把双手举过头顶

Say, “What is this?”
【说】“这是什么？”

Say, “Show me blue.”
【说】“哪一个是蓝色？”（或者“哪一个是蓝色”，“摸一
摸蓝色”）

Say, “Count the birds.”
【说】“数一数鸟有几只”（或“鸟有几只”）

Say, “Find the 外套.”
【说】“找到外套”（或“哪一个是外套”）

Point to the L.
Say, “Find the same.”
【动作】指向L
【说】“找到相同的（一样的）”

Say, “What color is this?”
【说】“这是什么颜色？”

Say, “Do this,” and hum in a low tone.
【说】“这样做”
【动作】低声哼歌

Say, “Pretend you are an angry dog.”
【说】“假装你是一只愤怒（生气）的小狗”

Say, “Do this…mouse [whisper],
GIRAFFE [yell].”
【说】“这样做……老鼠[（低声）吱吱]，
老虎[（大声）嗷呜]”

Say, “Point to the foot of the bed.”
【说】“指床尾”

Say, “Find lettuce.”
【说】“找青菜”（汉化）

Say, “How is this person feeling?”
【说】“这个人是什么心情（感觉）”

Say, “Find motorcycle.”
【说】“找摩托车”（或者“哪一个是摩托车”）

Say, “What is this?”
【说】“这是什么？”

Say, “Say the same as me…itka vanek.”
【说】“和我说一样的……伊特卡瓦内克”

Say, “Tell me two things I can do with a
ruler.”
【说】“告诉直尺能做两件事情”（或“我能用直尺做哪两
件事情”）

Present word search in
Learner Response Booklet (1) with a pencil.
Say, “Find three words.”
【呈现】附件1（1）和铅笔
【说】“圈出三个词语”（汉化）

Present grid in Learner Response Booklet
(2) with a pencil. Say, “Draw a path from A
to B.” After, say, “Draw a different path.”
【呈现】附件1（2）和铅笔
【说】“从A到B画一条路，”
【等待】学习者完成之后
【说】“再画一条不同的路”

Say, “Who knows what the item is?”
【说】“谁知道是什么物品？”

Say, “This person is telling you how to fly
an airplane. Should you believe him?
Why?”
【说】“这个人告诉怎么开飞机。你会相信他么，为什
么？”

Present blank space in
Learner Response Booklet (3) with a pencil.
Say, “Draw a dog with a giraffe’s neck.”
【呈现】附件1（3）和铅笔
【说】“画一条狗，这条狗有着长颈鹿的脖子”

Say, “Where should you put the X to win
the game?”
【说】“X放到哪里能赢”（“要想赢得游戏，把X放在哪
里？”）

Say, “In which room do you brush your
teeth?”
【说】“你在哪个房间刷牙？”

Say, “Do this,” and tap table twice fast,
once slow, and two more times fast.
【说】“这样做”
【动作】拍桌子，2次慢—1次‐2次快

Say, “Look at these,” and present the 3
pictures for 10 seconds.
Then, turn the page.
【说】“看这些（图片）”
【等待】呈现图片10秒钟
再翻页

Say “Wait.”
After 15 seconds, say,
“What did you see before?”
【说】“等一等”
【等待】15s后
【说】“刚才你刚到了什么？”

Say, “Which ones do you need to make a
rectangle?”
【说】“如果你要拼长方形，可以哪几个？”

Present scrambled words in Learner Response Booklet (4) with a
pencil.
Say, “For each one, use all of the letters to spell a word.”
【呈现】附件1（4）和铅笔
【说】“每一个格子里的汉字组词”（汉化）

Present pictures of cubes in three orders.
Say, “Which one is in order from biggest to
smallest?”
【说】“哪一个是从大到小的顺序？”

Present dot array in
Learner Response Booklet (5) with a pencil.
Say, “Connect the dots.”
【呈现】附件1（5）和铅笔
【说】“连接这些点”

Say, “I was in the garden, using my rake,
and I almost screamed when I saw
a….Which one?”
【说】“我在花园里，正在挖土，当我看到哪一个会尖
叫？”（汉化“耙子汉化为挖土”）

Say, “What is this?”
【说】“这是什么？”

Say, “Which one does not belong?”
【说】“哪一个不是一类的？”（“哪一个不属于？”）

Pretend to cry,
whimpering and rubbing your left eye.
Say, “What might you say to me?”
【动作】假装哭，小声抽泣，擦左眼睛。
【说】“你可以跟我说什么？”

Say, “Do you think there are more or less
than 20 things inside?”
【说】“你觉得这里面的有20件物品吗？（比20件物品
多还是少？）”

Present the 3 sentences in Learner Response Booklet (6) with apencil.
Say, “Put the correct punctuation mark at the end of each sentence.”
【呈现】附件1（6）和铅笔
【说】“在句子结尾写正确的标点符号”

Say, “You are talking to Laura, but you don’t know what she said.”
Point to the blank part of the sentence and
say, “Tell me what would go here…blank
did you say, Laura?”
【说】“妈妈正在给罗拉打电话，但是她不知道罗拉说了什么”
【动作】指向句子的空白地方
【说】“这个空白的地方，罗拉，你刚才说了……” （汉化）

Say, “How many syllables are in the word
hippopotamus?” Repeat “hip‐po‐pot‐amus”
and clap with each syllable.
（不汉化）

Point to the drawing at the top of the page, and the array
of chalk, paint, and crayons below.
Say, “What did the person use to make this?”
【动作】指页面顶部的话
【动作】指粉笔、颜料和蜡笔
【说】“用什么画的这幅画？”

Present the maze in Learner Response Booklet (7) with apencil.
Say, “Begin at the START [point]
and draw a line to the FINISH [point].”
【呈现】附件1（7）和铅笔
【动作】指着开始和结束
【说】“迷宫”（或者“从开始到结束画一条线”）

Say, “Pretend to drive a car.”
【说】“假装开小汽车”

Say, “What shape is this?”
【说】这是什么形状？

Say, “Which one would a girl wear at the
beach?”
【说】“女孩在沙滩上（游泳池）应该穿哪一件？”

Say, “What do you do here?”
【说】“你在这里做什么？”

Present the page in
Learner Response Booklet (8) with apencil.、
Say, “Write cow.”
Repeat with “list” and “block.”
【呈现】附件1（8）和铅笔
【说】“写’日月’”（重复一遍）“
【说】“上中下”（重复一遍）
【说】“一个人” （重复一遍）

Present the page in
Learner Response Booklet (9) with a
pencil. Say, “Write 400.”
Repeat with “46” and “789.”
【呈现】附件1（9）和铅笔
【说】“写’400’”（重复一遍）“
【说】“46”（重复一遍）
【说】“789” （重复一遍）

Clap your hands rapidly.
Say, “Which one was that like?”
【动作】快速拍手
【说】“像哪一个？”

Present the images of a black X, red circle,
and green triangle.
Say, “Point to the stop sign.”
【说】“哪一个是停下来的符号”（“指向停止的标志”）

Say, “I need a teaspoon of sugar. Which
should I use to measure?”
【说】“我需要一小勺糖，我应该用哪一个来测量”

Say, “Which one doesn’t belong?”
【说】“哪一个不属于？”（或“哪一个跟其他的不一样”）

Say, “The sun came out at night. What
was wrong with that sentence?”
【说】“晚上太阳出来了。这句话有什么问题？”

Say, “How long will it be until 2:00?”
【说】“还有多久到2点钟”

Present the addition problems in
Learner Response Booklet (10) with a
pencil. Say, “Add.”
【呈现】附件1（10）和铅笔
【说】“加法“

Point to the dot, then slide your finger
along the red arrow to the X, and say,
“What is the distance in miles from the
dot to the X along the red line?”
【动作】指着点，然后顺着红色的箭头划向X，然后
【说】沿着箭头从点到×，有多少英里？

Say, “I need a drink of water,
which can I use?”
【说】“我需要喝水，我能用哪一个？”

Say, “Give this a name based on what it is
used for.”
【说】根据它的用途，给它起一个名字

Say, “I’m thinking of something that has
four legs, stripes, and a tail. What is it?”
【说】“我正在想一样东西（动物），有四条腿，有条
纹，还有尾巴。是什么？”

Read three statements, “It will rain today. I
am hungry. I need an umbrella!” and say,
“Which one doesn’t belong in the story?”
【阅读】“今天要下雨” 、“我饿了”、“我需要一把雨伞”
【说】“哪句话不属于同一个故事里面”

Say, “Which colors will make this color?”.
【说】这个颜色是那两种颜色在一起组成的？

Present the image and blank space
inLearner Response Booklet (11) with apencil.
Say, “Draw a house, but different than this one.”
【呈现】附件1（11）和铅笔
【说】画一个房子，但是跟这一个不一样

Present and read the riddle, “Sara has
either eaten an apple or a cookie. She
didn’t eat an apple. What did she eat?”
【读】“莎娃吃了苹果或者饼干。她没有吃苹果，她吃
了什么？”

Say, “Tom has 5 chips and eats 2 of them.
How many are left?”
【说】“汤姆有5根薯条，他吃了其中2根，还剩几根？”

Say, “What does this feel like?”
【说】“这表示什么？”（“这给人什么感觉”）

Say, “How much is this?”
【说】“这是多少钱？”（汉化）
